exam.title: Splunk Core Certified User
exam.study_prerequisites: No prerequisite is published. Build entry-level fluency in the Splunk interface, time-bounded searches, fields, SPL pipelines, transforming commands, reports, dashboards, lookups, schedules and alerts using approved synthetic data.

review.notes: All eight blueprint domains are mapped from user-interface orientation through scoped SPL, fields and transformations to reusable reports, dashboards, lookups, schedules and alerts. Three connected scenarios, safe labs and original checks require observable evidence. Splunk Help, O'Reilly and Udemy endpoints were automation-blocked rather than missing; the official certification and blueprint pages were reachable. No recalled/live item, answer dump or copied course question is used.
